description: Eliminate N+1 query patterns across the application by ensuring all Supabase queries join related tables in a single query instead of fetching parent records then looping to fetch children. The primary pattern to fix is reports/advisories/operations fetching categories/departments/profiles in separate queries. This reduces query count from hundreds to single-digit per page load.
steps: 1. Audit all Supabase queries in src/screens/AdminDashboard.jsx (all tab functions), src/screens/HomeScreen.jsx, src/components/dashboard/ElNinoMonitoringDashboard.jsx for N+1 patterns (loops with queries, .map() followed by individual fetches)

2. Fix reports queries in AdminDashboard.jsx fetchData function: change from .select('*') to .select('*, categories(id, name, icon, department_id, departments(id, name, accent_color))') to fetch all related data in ONE query

3. Fix advisories queries in AdminDashboard.jsx AdvisoriesTab and HomeScreen.jsx: add profiles join to existing departments join: .select('*, departments(id, name, accent_color), profiles(id, full_name, email)')
4. Fix hospital_daily_records queries to join any lookup tables (hospitals, conditions, etc.) in single query
5. Fix cdrrmo_daily_operations queries to join operation_types, resources, evacuation centers if applicable
6. Fix bfp_operations queries to join fire_stations, equipment, personnel if applicable
7. Fix agriculture_damage_reports queries to join farmer/location lookups if applicable
8. Verify ReportCard.jsx component (src/components/ui/ReportCard.jsx) makes no Supabase calls—should only receive props
9. Verify MapPins.jsx and map components (src/components/map/*.jsx) have no loops triggering per-marker queries
10. Document all query changes in FEAT-002 findings for future reference
acceptance_criteria: Browser Network tab shows each data fetch is a single Supabase query, not N separate queries
Reports query returns nested categories and departments objects without additional queries
Advisories query returns nested departments and profiles objects without additional queries
No grep matches for patterns like 'data.map(async item => supabase.from' or similar loop-query combinations
ReportCard.jsx has no supabase import or query logic
MapPins.jsx and map components have no per-marker Supabase queries
All admin dashboard tabs load with <10 network requests total (down from potentially 100+)
verification: npm run dev, navigate to admin dashboard
Open DevTools Network tab, filter for supabase.co requests
Click through Reports, Advisories, Hospital tabs
Verify each tab makes 1-3 queries max, not dozens
Inspect query responses: confirm nested related data present (e.g., report.categories.departments)
grep -r 'supabase' src/components/map/MapPins.jsx (should return no matches or only static imports)
